description: Abstract class for handling message push nodes in Thingsboard rule engine, managing different message types, events, and alarms.

classes.name: AbstractTbMsgPushNode
classes.description: Abstract class implementing TbNode for message processing in Thingsboard, handling various message types and event building.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with configuration, converting it to specific config class.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, filtering by source and supported types, then processes or fails.

methods.name: buildEvent
methods.description: Constructs event data based on message type, including alarms and attribute updates.

methods.name: getAlarmActionType
methods.description: Determines the action type for alarm messages based on metadata.

methods.name: buildEvent
methods.description: Abstract method to build event with tenant, action, entity, type, and body.

methods.name: getEventTypeByEntityType
methods.description: Abstract method to get event type based on entity type.

methods.name: getAlarmEventType
methods.description: Abstract method to get alarm event type.

methods.name: getIgnoredMessageSource
methods.description: Abstract method to specify message source to ignore.

methods.name: getConfigClazz
methods.description: Abstract method to get configuration class type.

methods.name: processMsg
methods.description: Abstract method to process supported messages.

methods.name: getUUIDFromMsgData
methods.description: Extracts UUID from message data if it contains an alarm.

methods.name: getScope
methods.description: Determines scope from metadata or configuration.

methods.name: getEdgeEventActionTypeByMsgType
methods.description: Maps message type to edge event action type.

methods.name: isSupportedMsgType
methods.description: Checks if message type is supported for processing.
